bandReport.notes: Band covers Q1-Q32 across p00 (Q1-Q7), p01 (Q8-Q14), p02 (Q15-Q20), p03 (Q21-Q27), p04 (Q28-Q32). Layout is two-column throughout: read LEFT column top-to-bottom then RIGHT column, and the numbering follows that order (p00 left 1-4, right 5-7; p01 left 8-10, right 11-14; p02 left 15-17, right 18-20; p03 left 21-24, right 25-27; p04 left 28-30, right 31-32). Q1 is the paper's first question, so nothing precedes it. DIRECTIONS: exactly one shared-stimulus block starts inside this band - the 'Consider the following for the next two (02) items that follow' flagstaff-on-tower block at the top of the p04 RIGHT column, governing Q31 and Q32. Both members are printed complete on p04, so the set is fully contained in this band; setLabel D31-32, context carried verbatim and identical on both. No Directions or 'Consider the following' block appears anywhere on p00-p03. SEAM (p04/p05): clean in both directions. Q32 is complete on p04 - its stem and all four options print there - and the D31-32 set closes with it (the block says 'next two (02)' and Q31, Q32 exhaust it, so nothing of that set reads forward onto p05). p05 was opened and NOT transcribed: it begins with a BRAND-NEW 'Consider the following for the next two (02) items that follow' block (AB is a straight road leading to the foot P of a tower of height h ...) whose Directions START on p05, so band b2 owns that block and its members Q33-Q34; p05 also carries a second such block starting mid-left-column (two parallel chords AB and CD of a circle, 60 cm and 80 cm, same side of centre O, 10 cm apart) governing Q35 onward, and a third at the top of the p05 right column below Q36 (Let p = x^4 - y^2z^2 ...) governing Q37-Q38 - all three start on p05 and are band b2's, none of them reach back into p04. FIGURES: ZERO. p00-p04 carry no printed diagram, chart or data table of any kind - every one of Q1-Q32 is fully stated in text, including the D31-32 flagstaff set, whose stimulus is prose with no accompanying figure. No question in this band sets hasFigure. MISPRINTS: two, both flagged on their questions and both confirmed at 6x from the source PDF - Q11 option (a) prints 'Onle one' and Q29 option (c) prints 'Onle two' (the same 'Onle' for 'Only' slip twice in one paper). Both are transcribed exactly as printed. CURRENCY: Q5 prints the rupee glyph; transcribed as 'Rs.' per the brief and consistent with the rest of this corpus (2020-1, 2024-1, 2024-2, 2025-1 all use 'Rs.'; the glyph appears in none of them). DECIMALS: the booklet sets a raised middle dot (927·27, 0·301, 1·5); transcribed as full stops per the brief.

questions.stem: If \(a^2 - bc = \alpha\), \(b^2 - ac = \beta\), \(c^2 - ab = \gamma\), then what is \(\dfrac{a\alpha + b\beta + c\gamma}{(a + b + c)(\alpha + \beta + \gamma)}\) equal to ?
If \((x - 1)^3\) is a factor of \(x^4 + \alpha x^3 + \beta x^2 + \gamma x - 1\), then the other factor will be :

A 2-digit number is such that the sum of the number and the number obtained by reversing the order of the digits of the number is 55. Further, the difference of the given number and the number obtained by reversing the order of the digits of the number is 45. What is the product of the digits ?

If A and B can finish a work in 10 days, B and C can finish the same work in 12 days, C and A can finish the same work in 15 days; then in how many days can A, B and C together finish half of the work ?
A person borrowed Rs. 10,000 at 12% rate of interest per annum compounded quarterly for a period of 9 months. What is the interest paid by him to settle his account after 9 months ?

is M, then what is the value of \(2M + 5\) ?

questions.stem: A man walks at an average speed of 3 km/hr from his home and reaches office 40 minutes early. If he walks at an average speed of 2 km/hr, he would reach office 40 minutes late. What is the distance between his home and office ?
If \(x\left(a - b + \dfrac{ab}{a - b}\right) = y\left(a + b - \dfrac{ab}{a + b}\right)\) and \(x + y = 2a^3\), then what is \(x - y\) equal to ?
Which one of the following is a factor of \(3\sqrt{3}x^3 + 2\sqrt{2}y^3 - 18xy + 6\sqrt{6}\) ?
What is number of digits in the expansion of \(125^{100}\) ? (Given \(\log_{10} 2 = 0.301\))

What is the HCF of

\(acx^3 + bcx^2 + adx^2 + acdx + bdx + bcd\)  and

\(adx^3 + acx^2 + bdx^2 + bcx + acdx + bcd\)

if \(\text{HCF}\,(c, d) = 1\), \(c \ne d\) ?
If \(x^n - py^n + qz^n\) is divisible by \(x^2 + abyz - bzx - axy\), then what is \(\dfrac{p}{a^n} - \dfrac{q}{b^n}\) equal to ?

Consider the following statements :

1. If \((a + b)\) is directly proportional to \((a - b)\), then \((a^2 + b^2)\) is directly proportional to ab.
2. If a is directly proportional to b, then \((a^2 - b^2)\) is directly proportional to ab.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
If \((3a + 6b + c + 2d) \times (3a - 6b - c + 2d) = (3a - 6b + c - 2d) \times (3a + 6b - c - 2d)\), then which one of the following is correct ?
If \(3\sin\theta + 5\cos\theta = 5\), then what is the value of \(5\sin\theta - 3\cos\theta\) equal to ?

The combined age of a man and his wife is 6 times the combined age of their children. Two years ago their combined age was 10 times the combined age of their children; and six years later their combined age will be 3 times the combined age of their children. How many children do they have if each child is at least 2 years old ?

What is

\(3(\sin x - \cos x)^4 + 6(\sin x + \cos x)^2 + 4(\sin x)^6 + 4(\cos x)^6\)

equal to ?
What is the value of \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta\), if \(\theta\) satisfies the equation \(\cot^2\theta - (\sqrt{3} + 1)\cot\theta + \sqrt{3} = 0\); \(0 < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{4}\) ?
Which one of the following is a value of \(\theta\), if \(\theta\) satisfies the equation \(\tan 2\theta \tan 4\theta - 1 = 0\); \(0 < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) ?
If \(\tan x = \dfrac{\sin\theta + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta - \cos\theta}\), \(\dfrac{\pi}{4} < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\), then what is \(\sqrt{2}\,\sin x\) equal to ?
How many values of \(\theta\) will satisfy the equation \((\sin^2\theta - 4\sin\theta + 3)(4 - \cos^2\theta + 4\sin\theta) = 0\), where \(0 < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) ?

questions.context:
Consider the following for the next two (02) items that follow :

A flagstaff stands on the top of a vertical tower. The angle of elevation of the top of the flagstaff from a certain place on the same horizontal level with the base of the tower is found to be \(\alpha\). Advancing a distance d towards the tower in the same horizontal plane, the angle of elevation of the top of the flagstaff is observed to be \(\beta\) and that of the top of the tower is observed to be \(\gamma\). Let H be the height of the top of the flagstaff from the base of the tower and h be the height of the tower.
questions.stem: Which one of the following is correct ?
flags: check-bands warns that options A/B and C/D 'carry identical text' — this is a CASE-FOLDING ARTIFACT of the probe (it lowercases before comparing) and NOT a printed duplicate. Case is the entire discriminator: the stimulus defines H as the height of the top of the FLAGSTAFF above the tower base and h as the height of the TOWER, and the four options pair them the four possible ways. Re-verified against a 6x crop of the source PDF: (a) H tan gamma - h tan beta, (b) h tan gamma - H tan beta, (c) H tan gamma - h tan alpha, (d) h tan gamma - H tan alpha. All four are distinct as printed; do not 'repair' them.
